evals.name: basic-sprint
evals.prompt: Generate a sprint report: Sprint 14. Completed: user auth (5pts), fix login redirect (3pts), add pagination (2pts). Carried over: payment integration (8pts) — waiting on external API.

assertions.name: file-exists
assertions.description: report.md exists in the output directory

assertions.name: stories_are_well_formatted
assertions.description: Completed story entries are formatted in a clear, informative way that communicates effort and work done to stakeholders

assertions.name: summary-line-present
assertions.description: Output contains a line starting with 'Completed:' that lists story count and total points

evals.name: no-carryover
evals.prompt: Sprint 15 report: finished everything. Completed stories: add dark mode (3pts), fix performance regression (5pts), update docs (1pt). Nothing carried over.

assertions.name: file-exists
assertions.description: report.md exists in the output directory

assertions.name: no-carryover-section
assertions.description: Output does not contain a 'Carried Over' section when nothing was carried over
